lookupRootField.name: match
lookupRootField.description: Find match details by the match id. id is a required input field.

args.name: id
args.description: The id of the Dota match to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include this id.

args.name: steamAccountId
args.description: The steam account id to include in this query, excluding all results that do not have this steam account id.

field.name: matchUp
field.description: Returns back a list of the hero matchups, showing how that hero's win rate is affected with or against other heroes.

args.name: heroId
args.description: The hero id to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include this hero.

args.name: heroIds
args.description: An array of hero ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these heroes.

args.name: week
args.description: The week to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include this week. The value is an epoc TimeStamp of the week of data you want. Leaving null gives the current week.

args.name: bracketBasicIds
args.description: An array of rank ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these ranks. The value ranges from 0-8 with 0 being unknown MMR and 1-8 is low to high MMR brackets. Example 7 is Divine.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Id representing how to order dryads and triads. Synergy is STRATZ formula to help determine the best outcome of wins and picks in one. Accepted Inputs : Synergy = 0, Pick = 1, Win = 2, Loss = 3, Disadvantage = 4, Advantage = 5

args.name: matchLimit
args.description: Minimum amount of MatchCount required for a Duo to qualify

args.name: skip
args.description: The amount of data to skip before collecting your query. This is useful for Paging.

args.name: take
args.description: The amount to have returned in your query. The maximum of this is always dynamic. Limit :

aggregateEndpoint.paginationUnit: skip/take page over hero dryad rows (argument descriptions); no match-level cursor

discoveredCapabilities.criteria: A population endpoint must be reachable without a required entity ID (player/team/league/match), must accept a hero-pair filter, a time filter and a rank-bracket filter, and must return match identities.

queries.matchLevelRequestsNote: Not issued: the schema exposes no endpoint that can enumerate the matches behind matchUp. Entity-scoped or subset endpoints (player/team/league matches, guides, rampages, live, search) were not used as substitutes.
queries.preliminaryIntrospection: One identical staging introspection was issued during development (not archived) to design this parser; the archived request is the authoritative one.

matchSets.note: Null match sets mean "not obtainable", never "zero matches".

bucketReconciliation.reason: No per-match timestamps for the matchUp population are available.
bucketReconciliation.productionBucketSemantics: bucket b covers [b·BUCKET_SEC, (b+1)·BUCKET_SEC); matchUp week argument = b·BUCKET_SEC
bucketReconciliation.perDirectionTimestampFilteringPossible: UNVERIFIED — both directions are requested with the same week argument; whether STRATZ assigns a match to a week identically for both heroes cannot be observed without match records.

winnerOrientation.reason: Winner/side data exists on individual match records, but the matches that make up matchUp cannot be enumerated, so winCount cannot be reconciled against match outcomes.

rootCause.explanation: The STRATZ schema provides only aggregate matchUp counts; no unscoped endpoint returns the match IDs behind them. A→B/B→A match sets, bucket assignment and winner orientation therefore cannot be checked, and the cause of reverse-direction count differences remains unknown.
